_comment: Defender definitions. Stats are level-1 values; each character level adds level_growth (multiplicative) to damage and special_power. interval = seconds between throws. range/throw_speed in metres(/s). accuracy 0-100.

pitcher.name: Pitcher
pitcher.bonus_text: On the Mound: +20% damage, +15% throw speed

catcher.name: Catcher
catcher.bonus_text: Behind the Plate: +15% damage, aura +50% radius

defenders.name: Ace
defenders.title: The Flamethrower
defenders.bio: A fireballing ace who has never met a radar gun he couldn't melt.

trait.name: Fastball
trait.text: Every 4th throw is a blazing fastball: double damage and sets the runner ablaze (12/s for 2s).

defenders.name: Rico
defenders.title: The Wall
defenders.bio: Nothing gets past Rico. Not fastballs, not runners, not excuses.

trait.name: Home Guard
trait.text: Runners within 4.5m are slowed 25% and take +10% damage from everyone.

defenders.name: Maya
defenders.title: Quicksilver
defenders.bio: The fastest glove in the league. Blink and the double play is already turned.

trait.name: Quick Hands
trait.text: 30% chance to fire a second throw at another runner. Dashes to tag runners that pass within 3.5m (double damage).

defenders.name: Jax
defenders.title: Cannon Arm
defenders.bio: Third base, fourth gear. Jax's throws dent steel plating.

trait.name: Cannon Arm
trait.text: Throws ignore 60% of armor and knock runners back 0.8m.

defenders.name: Kai
defenders.title: Hawkeye
defenders.bio: Kai can thread a throw through a keyhole from the warning track.

trait.name: Precision
trait.text: +50% damage to runners over 10m away. Critical hits deal 2.5x.

defenders.name: Bruno
defenders.title: The Mountain
defenders.bio: Bruno doesn't throw the ball so much as launch it.

trait.name: Heavy Hitter
trait.text: Throws splash 2m around the target and stun for 0.4s.

defenders.name: Nova
defenders.title: Live Wire
defenders.bio: A closer with a lightning arm. Her fastball arrives before the thunder.

trait.name: Static Charge
trait.text: Every throw arcs to one extra runner for 50% damage.

defenders.name: Dex
defenders.title: The Closer's Shadow
defenders.bio: A slick shortstop who lives for the pickoff.

trait.name: Pickoff Artist
trait.text: Deals double damage to runners below 30% health.

defenders.name: Hana
defenders.title: Gap Hunter
defenders.bio: Hana covers more grass than the groundskeeper.

trait.name: Gap Shooter
trait.text: +40% damage to Sprinters, Jumpers and airborne runners.

synergies.name: The Battery
synergies.text: Pitcher and Catcher within 12m: both throw 15% faster.

synergies.name: Double-Play Duo
synergies.text: Two infielders within 14m: their throws ricochet to a second runner for 35% damage.

synergies.name: Outfield Wall
synergies.text: Two outfielders on the grass: +15% range for the whole team.

synergies.name: Fire and Ice
synergies.text: Ace and Kai together: critical hits ignite runners.
